question: The surface area of a sphere is 4π cm². The volume of the sphere is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area = 4πr² = 4π ⇒ r² = 1 ⇒ r = 1 cm.

Volume = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π(1)³ = 4π/3 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 4π/3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Surface area** of the **sphere** = 4π cm².

**Formula used:** **Surface area** = 4πr²; **Volume** = (4/3)πr³.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22e98ea39ea6c5aa5c0340d25dd4bb15df39e72b4ba0ccb7ae5cf63e3f82e3b2.png] 

⇒ 4πr² = 4π

⇒ r² = 1

⇒ **Radius (r)** = 1 cm

⇒ **Volume** = (4/3) × π × (1)³

⇒ **Volume** = 4π/3 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4π/3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Hemisphere formulas

For a **hemisphere** of radius r, **Curved Surface Area** = 2πr² and **Total Surface Area** = 3πr².

Volume of Hemisphere

The **volume** of a **hemisphere** is exactly half of a sphere: V = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio of SA to Volume

For any **sphere**, the ratio of its **Surface Area** to its **Volume** is 3/r.</p
